summary: Persistently elevated blood pressure; a leading modifiable risk factor for stroke, MI, heart failure, and CKD. Affects an estimated 47.7% of US adults (CDC). Diagnosed by repeated office/ambulatory BP measurement and staged by severity. Per the 2025 AHA/ACC/multisociety guideline, management is lifestyle modification plus pharmacotherapy from three first-line classes (thiazide/thiazide-like diuretic, long-acting dihydropyridine CCB, ACE inhibitor or ARB), targeting <130/80 for most adults.

news.what: 2025 AHA/ACC/multisociety High Blood Pressure Guideline (JACC), press 2025-08 - first major revision since 2017: universal <130/80 target for most adults; PREVENT equations replace Pooled Cohort Equations for 10-yr CVD risk; renal denervation introduced as adjunctive option for selected resistant hypertension; primary aldosteronism screening expanded regardless of serum potassium.

FDA approved baxdrostat (Baxfendy, AstraZeneca), first-in-class aldosterone synthase inhibitor, as add-on for uncontrolled hypertension. Phase 3 BaxHTN: 2 mg reduced seated SBP 15.7 mmHg from baseline, 9.8 mmHg vs placebo at week 12. No drug row on this card pending label verification (see notOnCard).
Only 20.7% of US adults with hypertension are controlled to <130/80.

drugs.warning: No boxed warning; symptomatic hypotension (esp. severe aortic stenosis); increased angina/MI risk on initiation/uptitration in severe obstructive CAD
No boxed warning; electrolyte/fluid imbalance (hypokalemia, hyponatremia)
No boxed warning; fluid/electrolyte imbalance; sulfonamide hypersensitivity
Boxed: fetal toxicity - discontinue as soon as pregnancy is detected; RAS-acting drugs in 2nd/3rd trimester reduce fetal renal function, increase fetal/neonatal morbidity and death
Boxed: fetal toxicity - discontinue as soon as pregnancy is detected; can cause injury and death to the developing fetus
Boxed: tumorigenic - hepatocellular adenomas, testicular interstitial-cell tumors (males), thyroid follicular-cell adenomas/carcinomas (both sexes) in chronic rat studies

notOnCard: Baxdrostat (Baxfendy) - approved 2026-05-18; label located but not parseable this pass, boxed-warning status unverified. No drug row until a direct label read confirms it.
Beta blockers - not among the three first-line classes in the 2025 guideline; remain compelling-indication agents (CAD, HF, arrhythmia). No label pulled this pass.
Lorundrostat - second aldosterone synthase inhibitor, NDA accepted, PDUFA 2026-12-22, not approved. Company-sourced only; omitted.
Renal denervation device specifics - sourced to device-maker press release, not an FDA PMA record; kept off the card as a device claim.
Hypertension prevalence denominator - CDC brief gives both 47.7% (adults 18+) and 49.1% (adults 20+), not reconciled; 47.7% used on card.
ACEi/ARB/direct renin inhibitor contraindication in pregnancy - noted on card as guideline statement, not an independent drug-label source for this card's scope (non-pregnant adults).

review.checked: 31 claims · 14 searches · 7 direct fetches with a browser user-agent

blocking.says: Drugs@FDA gives NDA 219878 submission status date 2026-05-15. Drugs.com's approval history independently gives May 15. Nothing supports May 18. Wrong in all four places it appears.

blocking.claim: Spironolactone row: boxed tumorigenicity, citing a 2014 label
blocking.says: Three problems from one root. The cited 2014 PDF says on its own face 'this label may not be the latest approved by FDA'. The current reference label (Rev 11/2025) has NO boxed warning at all — the PLR conversion removed it. And the row omits HYPERKALEMIA, which is both a contraindication and the lead Warning, on a row explicitly scoped to add-on use in resistant hypertension stacked on an ACEi or ARB. Marketed generics do still carry the old box, so the claim is stale and inconsistent rather than fabricated.

fixes.change: Published online 2025-08-14. The 2025-05 appears to have been read off the DOI suffix, which is not a publication date.

fixes.claim: Lisinopril boxed warning includes a 2nd/3rd trimester clause
fixes.change: Not in the box. The box says discontinue as soon as pregnancy is detected, full stop. As written the card narrows a boxed warning toward LESS caution in the first trimester.

fixes.claim: Gaps note about an unreconciled 47.7% vs 49.1% prevalence denominator
fixes.change: DELETE. '49.1' appears zero times in the cited CDC brief. 47.7% is correct and correctly labelled — the note asserts a figure its own source does not contain.

fixes.claim: Baxdrostat has no drug row because its boxed-warning status is unverified
fixes.change: Now determined: NO boxed warning, no contraindications, W&P hyperkalemia and hyponatremia. It earns a row.

verified: The 2025 AHA/ACC multisociety guideline exists and is current, and ALL SIX specifics check out: <130/80 target, three first-line classes, two agents at 140/90, PREVENT replacing the Pooled Cohort Equations, renal denervation as Class 2b, aldosteronism screening regardless of potassium
Losartan's fetal-toxicity boxed warning is accurate and complete
'No boxed warning' is correct for amlodipine, chlorthalidone and hydrochlorothiazide — verified absences, not parsing misses
47.7% prevalence and 20.7% controlled to <130/80 are both exactly right
All three BaxHTN figures confirmed off the label itself
Beta-blocker omission judged SAFE as disclosed — they are not first-line in the 2025 guideline and the gaps note preserves their compelling indications
couldNotVerify: Nothing material. Two publisher bot-blocks were worked around via independent primary sources.
